_doc: Mimir voice-to-fabrication config (spec 02). Host: db-host (on-LAN, personal tailnet, always-on). v0 = one printer (Ender-3/Moonraker), both gen paths, trust-gated start_print. All endpoints + exact model IDs are tunable here without code change.

listen._doc: Bind the db-host tailnet IP so ONLY the Odin gateway (tailnet) can reach the actuator — NOT 0.0.0.0 (audit finding). FAB_API_KEY is still required (defense in depth). Use 127.0.0.1 to lock to loopback for local-only testing.

watch._doc: Spec 11 gate 6 — post-dispatch print watcher (poll Moonraker, close jobs honestly).

ender3._doc: Creality Ender-3 V3 KE @ localhost — Klipper/Moonraker :7125. Kept powered OFF between prints (502 when off). api_key: set if Moonraker is not LAN-trusted.

slicer._doc: PrusaSlicer CLI. Profile picked per material: explicit request override > .loaded_material state file (flip via POST /fab/material on spool swap) > legacy config_ini fallback. An override that contradicts the loaded spool is REFUSED at slice time (slicing PETG on the PLA profile ground the extruder for an evening — 2026-07-18). Profiles are exports of the machine's own proven config — measure the printer, don't trust forums.

materials._doc: Spec 11 gate 5 — per-material temp windows the gcode linter enforces on EVERY slice. A profile edit can never ship 255C PLA.

openscad._doc: Headless render. render_cmd wraps xvfb-run for PNG (needs GL); STL export doesn't. LIVE-VERIFY xvfb/OSMesa availability on the host.

generation._doc: provider=ollama (local, no rate limits, private — hybrid-inference; OpenRouter here is free-tier-only = 402 on paid, 429 on free). For higher-quality functional CAD, point openscad_model at a stronger model with provider=openrouter AND your own OpenRouter key (higher limits). Functional CAD is hard — expect iteration (max_openscad_attempts re-prompts with the render error).
generation._provider_note: local Ollama on worker (qwen2.5:7b) — free/private/no-limit, enabled by the 4GB worker swap (2026-07-08). Swap-backed so gen is slow (~1-2min/part); fine for low volume. For higher CAD quality/speed, flip provider=openrouter with your own funded key, or move inference to a dedicated node (plan M4).

meshy._doc: Decorative path. Requires MESHY_API_KEY (get one at meshy.ai — free tier). Degrades gracefully if the key is absent.

embedding._doc: Model cache vectors — same space as the memory spine (Ollama nomic-embed-text, 768). Falls back to trigram match if unreachable.

cache._doc: Retrieve proven models to skip regeneration. min_similarity = cosine floor for a reuse hit.

retrieval._doc: Retrieval-first: search existing repos for a PROVEN, print-tested community STL instead of gambling on generated geometry. Provider-abstracted; a downloaded STL feeds the same slice->approve->print pipeline. Thingiverse needs THINGIVERSE_TOKEN (free app at thingiverse.com/apps/create). Ranked by downloads*2+likes.

kiln._note: MyMiniFactory/Cults3D via Kiln — not implemented yet

obico._doc: Obico (self-hosted on db-host, https://obico.example.internal) already does AI print-failure detection + its own alerting on the linked Ender-3 (printer_id 1). We just hand the user its live monitor URL on dispatch — Obico watches independently. Its presence is the 'printer-cam monitoring' half of the prerequisite to later raise the fabrication ceiling propose->bounded (the other half = a home-presence check). API is OAuth2; not needed for the URL handoff.
